settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Company details, formats and texts used across the product, on documents and in e-mails. Changes apply at once and are recorded in the audit log.

image.type: Choose a PNG or JPEG image.
image.size: The image is larger than 200 KB.

company.legalName: Shown under the name on documents.
company.logo: PNG or JPEG, up to 200 KB. Printed at the top of documents.

format.currencyCode: ISO code shown next to amounts, for example ETB.
format.timeZone: IANA name, for example Africa/Addis_Ababa. Used for dates on documents and e-mails.

mail.fromName: Name recipients see. The sender address comes from the server configuration.
mail.replyTo: Where replies go. Leave empty to use the sender address.
mail.footer: Closing lines of every e-mail (confidentiality notice, contact details).

documents.accentColor: Colour of headings and rules on documents and of the button in e-mails.
